text:
Plan 24 modules (final list): metrics, reports, scheduler, notify, upload, catalog, session, auth, gateway, ingest, quota, archive, search, audit, billing, sync, shipping, inventory, pricing, profile, tenant, media, cache, indexer.

Fixed: metrics workers=32 timeout=55; reports workers=14 batch=350; scheduler workers=14 batch=400; notify batch=750; upload batch=700; catalog ttl=390; session ttl=330; auth ttl=240; gateway ttl=180; ingest workers=16; quota workers=20; archive queue_depth=450; search batch=400.

Limits: session queue_depth<=20; quota queue_depth<=30; notify workers>=30; media timeout>=120; inventory retry<=3; auth batch<=100; tenant retry>=8; shipping batch>=900.

Owners: gamma (audit, quota, ingest); delta (billing, search, sync); alpha (shipping); beta (inventory).

Same worker: reports+billing, search+archive, metrics+session, gateway+inventory. Different workers: metrics/quota, pricing/shipping, profile/billing, profile/search.

Files: worker.py→quota, adapters.py→tenant, client.py→metrics, core.py/serial.py→profile, stubs.py→audit, models.py→notify, jobs.py→inventory.

Deps: quota→archive, gateway→ingest, cache→search, tenant→session, archive→scheduler, catalog→audit.

Forbidden (direct or transitive): archive→media, reports→scheduler, pricing→reports, gateway→indexer.

Order: inventory before reports; media before cache; shipping and session before indexer.

Everything else is your call.
